narration.full_text: Namaste students! In this session, we'll embark on an exciting journey to understand how living organisms, both plants and animals, manage their internal functions and respond to the world around them. Get ready to explore the fascinating mechanisms of control and coordination! By the end of this session, you will be able to explore the structure and function of the nervous system, including neurons and reflex actions. Delve into the human brain's parts and their specific roles. Discover how plants coordinate their responses to stimuli. And finally, understand the crucial role of hormones in animal control and coordination.
